answer: Sybil resistance arises from bonded collateral escrows that make identity multiplication economically unsafe: when k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated statements, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the implicated swarm, causing collateral to erode like a glacier advancing through a vine of linked accounts, while delta-defined evidence thresholds limit false correlation claims.
